DZ-SS13/001EN
King of Knights, Alfred
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield
[CONT]:The normal ride of this card from a grade 3 card with an Aichi icon and a different card name from this card also becomes a persona ride.
[CONT](VC):During your turn, this unit cannot be boosted, and this unit gets [Power]+2000 for each of your rear-guards. If you have three or more rear-guards, this unit gets drive +1, if you have four or more, and you persona rode this turn, this unit gets [Critical]+1.
[AUTO](VC)[1/Turn]:When this unit attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], search your deck for up to two cards with an Aichi icon, call each of them to (RC) in the same column, and shuffle the deck. If your opponent's vanguard is grade 3 or greater, all of those called units get [Power]+5000 until end of turn.
